title: Co-op D-pad: pawn orders or signals (DPC 0.9.177-dev23)
intro: About 3 minutes, co-op with player 2 joined. 'Co-op players' D-pad' in the mod's Co-op: details settings switches the mode by hand.

probes.errs: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'dev_status/DirectPawnControl.json'); return ok and d and d.errors
probes.mode: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.R.cp and ((D.R.cp.on and D.R.cp.mode) or (D.coop.active and 'classic') or 'off')
probes.last: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; local r = D and D.R.dord_last; return r and (tostring(r.who) .. ': ' .. tostring(r.name) .. ' order=' .. tostring(r.order) .. ' gesture=' .. tostring(r.ges) .. ' node=' .. tostring(r.node)) or 'none'
probes.n: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.R.dord_n or 0
probes.played: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.R.dord_played or 0
probes.order: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; local pc = D and D.R.dord_pc_obj; return pc and pc:call('get_ActiveOrder') or -1
probes.dord_mode: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.cfg.coop_dpad_orders

steps.text: Co-op D-pad orders: co-op on with player 2 (3 too if you can), out of combat, weapons sheathed, standing still. Press End.

REAL ORDERS. Player 2 taps the D-pad (nothing else held), one direction every few seconds: UP (Go), DOWN (Come), LEFT (Wait), RIGHT (Help). Watch: does player 2's character gesture? Do the free pawns obey and answer? Press End (30 s).
Real orders: up, down, left, right
SIGNALS ONLY. Same again: UP, DOWN, LEFT, RIGHT. The character should gesture, and the pawns should NOT change what they are doing. Press End (25 s).
Items still work: player 2 holds L1 and taps DOWN (the stamina item), then holds L1 and taps UP. No gesture should play. Press End (15 s).
In a fight (optional): find something to fight, and player 2 taps UP (Go) mid-fight. The order should still go out, with no gesture while attacking. Press End (30 s), or skip with Page Down.
Done. Tell Claude: did the gestures look right, did the pawns answer out loud, and which mode do you want as the default?
